summary: Rockingham County structure, typed by the Forest Fire Lookout Association as a possible tower (Tower?) and listed as gone; no build, staffing or fate sources found.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone; the association marks the type as uncertain and gives no removal date.

evidence.supports: entry called Third Hill in Rockingham County at 38.65519, -78.92140, listed as gone, type marked with a question mark (possible tower)
entry filed under other or unknown structures
the summit is in Rockingham County
the only tower mention on the page is the High Knob Fire Tower, which the page lists among other popular places

corrections.why: The association files the Third Hill entry under Other or Unknown Structures and marks its type with a question mark, so it is not a confirmed tower.

sources.title: Third Hill – Routes & How to Get There

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only source that names this structure is the association's Virginia list, which gives name, county, coordinates and gone status, and marks the type with a question mark under Other or Unknown Structures. Two web searches and the Komoot and Wikipedia pages gave no build, staffing, fire, removal or access detail, so the story is short and no sentence was padded. The Komoot page describes a summit, not a tower, and is cited only for the place name and for naming the High Knob Fire Tower as its only tower mention. Do not confuse with Third Hill Mountain in Berkeley County, WV. The story stays under the 120-word target because the evidence does not support more.
